test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: And he wanted to sea him sufer.
And he wanted to see him sufer.
And he wanted to see him suffer.
And he wantted to see him suffer.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e.** 'And he wanted to see him suffer.'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, only option 3 is a sentence with no spelling error.

 
• **'Option 1' **i.e. 'And he wanted to sea him sufer.' uses** 'sea' **instead of** 'see' **and **'sufer'** instead of** 'suffer'.**
 
• **'Option 2' **i.e. 'And he wanted to see him sufer.' uses **'sufer' **instead of** 'suffer'.**
 
• **'Option 4' **i.e. 'And he wantted to see him suffer.' uses** 'wantted'** instead of** 'wanted'.**

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- *'And he wanted to see him suffer.'*
